identityCollisionHandling: Relation IDs are not unique across repeated scope records in this graph; each occurrence is represented as relationId#ordinal within its graph. Exact canonical payload matches are retained; same-id endpoint matches with changed metadata are retained with explicit change records.

token-reference|semantic-candidate.rule: Supported token declaration→var() relation only; unsupported/ambiguous selector/token forms remain unresolved.

uses-token|semantic-candidate.rule: Candidate consumer relations only; no strict proof or authorization.

css-cascade|semantic-candidate.rule: Exact unique intrinsic static owner; zero/multiple/global/custom-boundary/dynamic/unsupported selectors remain unresolved.

notes: Full edge payloads remain in b11-graph-base.json and b11-graph-final25d8.json.
